features.title: GST Invoice PDF Generation and Email Dispatch Resilience
features.description: Enhance invoice rendering and purchase confirmation email pipeline to ensure background job isolation, PDF font reliability, and decoupled error handling so SMTP failures never roll back paid transactions.
acceptanceCriteria: PDF invoices render sequential numbering (INV-2026-xxxxx) with valid GST tax breakdown
Email delivery failures are caught gracefully and logged to EmailLog table
Order status remains PAID even if PDF rendering or SMTP transmission encounters a network timeout
features.notes: Ready for verification and stress testing.
